name: StoryWhiteBlue
tagline: A small library of stories born from dreams.
description: A small independent library of fiction by Erkan, made for unhurried reading.
about: I write from Berlin, collecting the small worlds that appear behind closed eyes and trying to remember them before morning fades them away.
StoryWhiteBlue is a quiet shelf for those stories. There's no schedule, no algorithm, no rush. New tales arrive whenever the sky decides to hum again.
If you spot a bug, or want to say hello, or have a thought about something you've read I'd love to hear from you.
